name: Open spots (ask to join, host accepts)
use_when: a plan already exists and has a few open spots that people outside the core group can ask for
'open it up', 'we have 2 extra spots', 'room for 3 more', 'let people request to join', 'plus ones'
someone (the host) decides who gets each spot: accept or decline each request
dont_use_when: everyone in the chat is invited and the question is who is in (use lock)
first come first served seats or beds with no host deciding (use slots)
shifts or tasks people sign up for (use shifts)
guarantees: accepted people never outnumber the open spots; a spot never holds two people
only a host accepts or declines, and only a waiting ask; hosts never ask
one ask per person; withdrawing frees the spot; a declined ask stays declined
a leaver's spot opens again; if every host leaves, the first person in the chat becomes host; a late joiner can ask at once

detail.description: One plain line with where, when, cost from the chat, e.g. 'Fri Jan 17 - Sun 19 · $85 each', or empty

hosts.description: Names of the people running the plan, exactly as in the members list; empty means the first person in the chat
